name: skills-review-and-polish
description: Authoring-time linter and surgical fixer for AI customizations (skills, instructions, agents, prompts). Finds contradictions, ambiguities, coverage gaps, and structural problems. VS Code extension provides AI-suggested fixes with diff preview for human review; MCP server returns proposed fixes for agent-controlled application.

skillsReviewAndPolish.provider.description: LLM provider. 'vscode-lm' uses your Copilot subscription (no API key). External providers require a key set via the 'Set API Key' command (stored in SecretStorage).

skillsReviewAndPolish.model.markdownDescription: Analysis model **id**. Empty = use the provider default / selected Copilot model, which is recommended for first run with `vscode-lm`. Use the _Skills Review: Select Analysis Model_ command to choose a specific model. **The picker marks the currently recommended OpenRouter models with ⭐.** See `scripts/e56-corpus-rescan-multimodel.mjs` and the [Recommended OpenRouter Models](docs/USER-GUIDE.md#recommended-openrouter-models) table for the experiment that produced the recommendations.

skillsReviewAndPolish.pickerSortBy.description: How to sort models in the picker. 'price' = per-million-token cost (cheapest first), 'multiplier' = Copilot premium request multiplier (lowest first), 'name' = alphabetical.

skillsReviewAndPolish.modelDisplayName.markdownDescription: _(Read-only — set automatically by the model picker.)_ Friendly name of the currently selected analysis model, shown here so you can see what `skillsReviewAndPolish.model` refers to without re-opening the picker.

skillsReviewAndPolish.deepModel.description: Model for the contradictions/deep wave. Empty = same as analysis model/provider default. **OpenRouter recommendation:** `deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3` paired with `google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite` as the standard model (see `scripts/e56-corpus-rescan-multimodel.mjs` and the [Recommended OpenRouter Models](docs/USER-GUIDE.md#recommended-openrouter-models) table in USER-GUIDE.md).

skillsReviewAndPolish.fixModel.description: Model for surgical fixes. A reasoning model is recommended. Empty = same as analysis model.

skillsReviewAndPolish.fixModelDisplayNam.markdownDescription: _(Read-only - set automatically by the model picker.)_ Friendly name of the currently selected fix model, shown here so you can see what `skillsReviewAndPolish.fixModel` refers to without re-opening the picker.

skillsReviewAndPolish.external.structure.markdownDescription: Structured JSON response mode for external providers. **Default: `schema`** — sends a strict JSON schema via `response_format: { "type": "json_schema" }` so OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic (Sonnet 4.5+), and Fireworks all return the analyzer's expected shape with no truncation. Set to `true` to use the legacy `response_format: { "type": "json_object" }` (only recommended for models that validated well under that mode). Set to `false` to omit `response_format` entirely (use only when both shapes are rejected). See `docs/plan/research/structured-output-provider-surfaces.md` for the probe matrix that informed the default.

skillsReviewAndPolish.external.requestTi.description: Maximum wall-clock time for a single external-provider HTTP request before it is cancelled.

skillsReviewAndPolish.external.maxRespon.description: Maximum output tokens requested from external providers (`max_tokens`). Increase this if long prompts are getting cut off.

skillsReviewAndPolish.external.adaptiveR.description: When enabled, scale response `max_tokens` per request from prompt length (bounded by min/max settings) instead of always using a fixed value.

skillsReviewAndPolish.external.adaptiveM.description: Upper bound for adaptive response-token sizing. Only used when external.adaptiveResponseTokens is enabled. Defaults higher than external.maxResponseTokens so long prompts can request more output than the fixed-mode ceiling.

skillsReviewAndPolish.external.minAdapti.description: Lower bound for adaptive response-token sizing. Ignored unless external.adaptiveResponseTokens is enabled.

skillsReviewAndPolish.external.adaptiveC.description: Heuristic scale used by adaptive response-token sizing: desired tokens = ceil(promptChars / this value). Lower values request more output tokens.

skillsReviewAndPolish.analysisMode.description: 'multiWave' runs 6 focused passes (best quality). 'focused' runs 2 high-signal passes — contradictions + ambiguities (faster, good quality). 'single' runs one combined prompt (cheapest/fastest, lower recall).

skillsReviewAndPolish.filterFindings.markdownDescription: Run the deterministic finding post-processor on analyzer output before reporting. **Recommended: keep on.** The post-processor suppresses false positives the LLM waves produce from reading project rules literally (e.g. flagging 'may' as weak obligation, flagging 'must not' as ambiguous, flagging a numbered procedure as unordered). **Off** if you want the raw analyzer output for debugging or for fuzz-testing your own prompts. The post-processor is purely deterministic — it does not change the underlying LLM behavior, only the finding list presented to you.

skillsReviewAndPolish.scoreSamples.description: Number of analyzer scans to median for keep/revert fix decisions. Collapses the ~±6 penalty noise floor. Use 1 for cheap scans, 3 for fixing.

skillsReviewAndPolish.include.description: Glob patterns for files treated as AI customizations.

skillsReviewAndPolish.exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude from analysis.

skillsReviewAndPolish.severityOverrides.description: Per-diagnostic-code severity overrides (ESLint-style). Map a code to error|warning|info|hint|off. Example: { "coverage-gap": "off", "contradiction": "error" }.

skillsReviewAndPolish.fixMode.description: 'diff' shows before/after for review; 'loop' auto-applies up to fixLoopMaxIterations; 'chat' hands off to Copilot Chat.

skillsReviewAndPolish.fixStrategy.description: 'subtractive' tightens by removing vagueness; 'additive' appends a concrete clause (append-only); 'improved' is scope-capped.

skillsReviewAndPolish.fixLoopMaxIteratio.description: Max fix-then-rescan iterations when fixMode is 'loop'.

skillsReviewAndPolish.fix.semanticCheck.description: Run an extra semantic-equivalence judge on each fix (extra API call).

skillsReviewAndPolish.fix.selfCritique.description: Audit each content-adding fix for fabricated facts (extra API call). Forced on for additive fixes.

skillsReviewAndPolish.fix.referenceGroun.description: Use a sibling references/ directory to ground factual fragments when fixing.

skillsReviewAndPolish.fix.guard.upperBou.markdownDescription: Maximum growth factor for fix output. Fixes exceeding this limit are rejected. For ambiguity-llm subtractive fixes, the effective limit is 1.1x regardless of this setting. For additive ambiguity fixes, the limit is `max(original × multiplier, original + 80)` to guarantee room for concrete clauses.

skillsReviewAndPolish.fix.guard.lowerBou.markdownDescription: Minimum size factor for fix output. Fixes shrinking below this limit are rejected. Prevents accidental deletion of entire sections.

skillsReviewAndPolish.fix.guard.maxAncho.markdownDescription: Maximum anchor text length for surgical fixes. Longer fragments are rejected to prevent structural damage. Increase only if you have long paragraphs that need fixing.

skillsReviewAndPolish.showScoreCodeLens.description: Show a CodeLens with the quality score and issue count at the top of customization files.

skillsReviewAndPolish.maxDiagnostics.markdownDescription: Maximum number of findings rendered as editor diagnostics. When a skill produces more findings, the top-N by severity are shown and the remainder are summarized with a 'Show All Findings' hint. Raise for large skills (e.g. 294K-char skills can produce 30+ findings).

skillsReviewAndPolish.experimental.inlin.description: EXPERIMENTAL: preview surgical rewrites as inline ghost text on flagged lines.

skillsReviewAndPolish.telemetry.enable.description: Reserved for future anonymous usage telemetry. Currently disabled and no telemetry is sent.

skillsReviewAndPolish.logLevel.description: Set the verbosity for extension logging. 'debug' shows wave lifecycle and model selection. 'trace' adds raw LLM request/response content — use for debugging 0-result or parse failures.

languageModelTools.name: skills-review-and-polish_analyze
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyzes an AI skill or instructions document for contradictions, ambiguities, coverage gaps, persona inconsistencies, and structural/hygiene issues. Returns a JSON array of diagnostics with codes, messages, severity, and line ranges.

text.description: The full text content of the skill/instructions document to analyze.

filePath.description: Optional absolute file path (used for domain hints and reference grounding).

languageModelTools.name: skills-review-and-polish_fix
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Surgically fixes a single identified issue in an AI skill or instructions document using safety-gated LLM rewriting. Returns the proposed fix text and risk flags for the caller to review.

relevantText.description: The exact verbatim text fragment to fix (the anchor).

scripts.compile: tsc -p ./ && rm -rf out/core/prompts && rm -rf out/core/prompts && cp -r src/core/prompts out/core/prompts && rm -rf out/assets && cp -r assets out/assets
scripts.test:calibration: npm run compile && RELEASE_GATE=1 node scripts/e50-clean-architecture.mjs
scripts.test:calibration:log: npm run compile && node scripts/run-with-log.mjs e50-calibration -- RELEASE_GATE=1 node scripts/e50-clean-architecture.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:log: node scripts/run-with-log.mjs e2e -- playwright test --config tests/playwright.config.ts
scripts.vitest:log: node scripts/run-with-log.mjs vitest -- vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.ts
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run refresh-fixtures && npm run compile
scripts.release:gate: npm run refresh-fixtures && npm run compile && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run lint:md
